_notes: Mini-pilot (task B1+B3, 2026-10-06; filled with the decisions of EMIR 2 Part 1 in task #67, 2026-10-07). prereg_approved stays false until the user approves prereg_minipilot.md: until then a real run (also --resume) does not start; dry runs work. Models: gemini-2.5-flash-lite left after pilot v2 (pilot_v2_degerlendirme.md K5), mistral-large-4-0 added. providers: tag / provider_name from GET /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints, checked 2026-10-06 (deepinfra/fp8 = DeepInfra fp8, as in pilot v2; mistral = Mistral; openai = OpenAI). Fallback off (allow_fallbacks false) and require_parameters true for all three (pgg_game.provider_routing). temperature and reasoning_effort are not sent (logged "default"). runs_dir must exist; outputs go to runs_dir/<run>/. run: the template minipilot_{run_date} gets the local date of the run start (YYYYMMDD) when a new run starts and is written to the summary (run_template); --resume needs the resolved name with --run. cards: cards/pilot_cards_v3.json (sha256 a4f50d0f...a9aa), Boston + Riyadh = 6 cards, styles minimal / value / factual of v3 (prereg name of factual: neutral procedure card, Q5). frames: abstract_v3 and story for all three models (Q2 (a), Q3 (b)); frame_files lock each file by sha256 (task #67 K1: another file stops the run and the dry run); story = frames/story_A.json (draft A, the jar, Q1), kind story: linted for the forbidden roots of cerceve_linter at every run start. Relative paths are relative to the code directory. comprehension = the two rule-comprehension questions of each frame (q2 with the sign sentence of task #67 K2). budget_usd = 6 is the hard cap on accumulated usage.cost; a real run does not start while the dry-run estimate is above expected_cost_gate_usd = 4.5 (Q4). isolated_round_no = 5: 'This is round 5 of 10.' (isolated_frame fixed_round). rationale, max_invalid, invalid_rate_cap, stop_on_length and workers: prereg_minipilot.md settings table (max_invalid 3 as in configs/pilot.json). parallel_units 3 (item 14), check_snapshot true (item 15), seed_namespace pgg-minipilot (item 13). Task #68 (EMIR 2 K3, K4, item 15): model_budget_usd = per-model caps on accumulated usage.cost (mistral 3, deepseek 2, gpt 0.5 USD; Q4): a model over its cap stops alone, the others go on; budget_usd 6 and the 4.5 USD gate stay. snapshot_version_models = [mistral]: check_snapshot compares Mistral's model_version (the dated model of the serving endpoint, openrouter_metadata; its response model has no date, task #59), which every row logs. A response of a pinned model without a provider name is re-requested and counted (n_provider_mismatch, n_provider_missing).
